digest.component_or_area: LLM provider parity harness for Bedrock substrate validation
propositions: Bedrock inference-profile model ids must be invoked in the project AWS account (896586841071/us-east-1) before corpus spend; both class slots (standard sonnet-4-6, frontier opus-4-8) are confirmed invokable with temperature=0 probed and capability overrides verified.

A paired corpus run with N=3 epochs across 30 sampled gold items (15 block, 15 advisory) from 15 specs must demonstrate payload equivalence, tool parity, and provider-clean routing — same system prompt, messages, tools and max_tokens reaching both providers, with model-id as the only differing field.

Bedrock's supports_temperature: False capability override for opus-4-8 must be validated in practice: zero sampling-parameter rejections across measured case-runs confirm the withdrawal mechanism works symmetrically across both providers.

Provider-clean routing assertion requires per-call model logging via REBAR_USAGE_LOG and tally of non-Bedrock calls on the v2 arm: both class slots must show zero non-bedrock provider calls in the recorded usage log.

The one legitimate capability difference found (temperature withdrawn from opus on both providers via model capability record, not provider-driven) must be enumerated and symmetric; any undocumented capability difference that alters the payload must be discovered and recorded before cutover.
